pages.text: The Soul Condenser is a passive way to generate souls early-game. You just need to place it and it starts collecting souls from the atmosphere. By default it generates 3/s souls. Unless you place it in the mods custom 'Shadowwood Forest', then the generation is multiplied tenfold.
This machine $(l)does NOT load chunks$() and $(l)does NOT need to be connected to the core.$()
